notes:
REF-BM-03: Collected title and description can be edited only after saving, not before.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and labels are editable, but bookmark notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate saves are prevented and the existing item is highlighted, but the user is not taken into editing it.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and URL, but there is no note field to search.
REF-BM-14: The search parser does not implement #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search expressions are not implemented.
REF-BM-16: An exact-phrase filter exists, but quoted phrases in the search term are not parsed.
REF-BM-23: Markdown notes and rendered note views are not implemented.
REF-BM-24: PDFs are preserved, but web pages are reduced to extracted text and an image rather than stored as single-file HTML snapshots.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is not implemented.
REF-BM-29: Saved filters include search text and included labels, but excluded tags are unsupported.
REF-BM-30: Netscape import preserves titles, dates, and folder-derived labels, but ignores explicit TAGS attributes.
